versions.changelog:
Initial release of Content Dependency Mapper: uncover and visualize hidden dependencies, critical assets, and optimization opportunities within your content library.

- Maps explicit and semantic content relationships to generate visual dependency graphs (JSON, DOT, GraphML, HTML).
- Assigns Content Criticality Scores (1–100) to each asset based on traffic impact, conversion influence, structure, maintenance, and recency.
- Detects content clusters, orphaned assets, bottlenecks, and strategic bundling opportunities.
- Produces fragility and gap analysis, with actionable editorial prioritization roadmaps.
- Supports data ingestion from popular platforms (WordPress, Notion, HubSpot, CSV/API exports) and optional analytics integration.
